items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I was sharing a dressing room with Stéphane Grappelli... I never had met him before... Stéphane said, 'Oh, c’est jolie, mon petit Toots.'

ctx.x: When I was sharing a dressing room with Stéphane Grappelli.
Okay. That’s good. So we want to correct the record, because it is listed as ’61 in this entry, so ’62 is when you wrote it.
